top_findings.title: SQL injection via a JSON array for year/isbn (charlist bypasses quote-escaping)
top_findings.evidence: lib/book_api/store.ex:80 `defp q(value), do: to_string(value)` — only binaries are escaped (store.ex:79); nullable/1 (store.ex:83) routes year/isbn through q/1. Router validate/1 (router.ex:51-55) checks only title/author, so {"year": [49,41,59,32,68,82,79,80,...]} decodes to an integer list, to_string/1 turns it into the raw text `1); DROP TABLE books; --` (verified: `elixir -e` prints it unescaped) and it is spliced into the INSERT at store.ex:31, which the sqlite3 CLI runs as multiple statements.
top_findings.suggestion: Validate year is an integer and isbn a string in the router; make q/1 reject non-scalars; better, use parameterized queries (Exqlite) instead of shelling SQL text to sqlite3.
